issue_context.title: Android phone icon is missing on homepage
issue_context.body:
### Description

Connecting a phone (maybe any removable drive) will add an entry under drives on homepage but the icon is blank.

### Steps To Reproduce

Connect a phone in MTP mode
Phone drive will appear on homepage
Icon for that drive will be missing

### Expected behavior

Load and display the drive's icon

### Files Version

Main

### Windows Version

Windows 10

### Relevant Assets/Logs

None
comments: Hi! I'm new to this project but I'd like to help. Can I try to fix this or someone else is working on it?

~Sure, feel free to work on it!~ Edit: sorry I've stumbled upon the cause of this issue. Since we're near the release of the next stable version I've patched this on the fly. Thanks for you interest in Files and feel free to pick up any open issue (the ones marked "good first issue" label are good choices).
